items.title: Do credit card points expire? Rules by issuer, airline, and hotel program
items.summary: General credit card rewards don't typically expire as long as your account is active and in good standing, but this can vary by card issuer and rewards program.

items.title: Dan Loeb and 8 Other Big Funds Bought Capital One Financial. Berkshire Hathaway and 14 Others Sold. Who’s Right?

items.summary: Berkshire's first big moves under Greg Abel include a surprise bet on a slumping homebuilder, a fresh IPO and trims to two bank holdings. The filing shows what changed, but the real question is what Abel saw that the market missed.
